name: Floating cp builder bar
body:
**v1.2.1**

- **Feature:** Added Floating builder bar — This allows for the cp builder to be selected and changed on the fly without needed to re-open the configuration.
- **Feature:** Reactive item use — automatically uses a bag item when a specific debuff texture is detected on the player. Fires every time the debuff is present and the item is off cooldown. Hourglass Sand is pre-configured to respond to the Bronze Dragon debuff (`INV_Misc_Head_Dragon_Bronze`). Additional item/debuff pairs can be added to `RoguePoker.reactiveItems`.
